title.en: Solar Panels That Plug Into Your Wall Are About to Be Everywhere
title.zh: 能直接插在你家墙上插座的太阳能板，即将随处可见。
title.gr: 主句 Solar panels … are about to be everywhere 用｛一般现在时表将来｝；that plug into your wall 是修饰 panels 的｛定语从句｝。
ph: 此处作表语，意为'普及、遍地开花'

paragraphs.en: California is the latest state to pass a law making it easier to install balcony-friendly solar panels.
hl: the latest state to pass a law
paragraphs.zh: 加州是最新一个通过法律、让"阳台友好型"太阳能板更易安装的州。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；the latest state to pass… 用｛不定式作后置定语｝（被最高级/序数词修饰的名词后常用 to do）；making it easier… 是｛现在分词短语作后置定语｝，其中 it 是｛形式宾语｝，真正宾语是 to install…panels，easier 是宾语补足语。

paragraphs.en: Renewable energy experts think the new technology is about to take off.
paragraphs.zh: 可再生能源专家认为，这项新技术即将腾飞。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；think (that)… 引导｛宾语从句｝，连词 that 省略。

paragraphs.en: On a quiet street in suburban South Salt Lake City, Utah, the stirring of an energy revolution is taking shape.
paragraphs.zh: 在犹他州南盐湖城郊区一条安静的街道上，一场能源革命的萌芽正悄然成形。
paragraphs.gr: ｛现在进行时｝ is taking shape，带有现场描写感；句首介词短语作地点状语。

paragraphs.en: There, outside the spare bedroom of an unassuming, thousand-square-foot midcentury home sit three angled solar panels plugged into a nearby outlet.
paragraphs.zh: 在那里，一栋不起眼的、约一千平方英尺的中世纪风格住宅的客卧外，放着三块倾斜的太阳能板，插头接在附近的插座上。
paragraphs.gr: ｛完全倒装句｝：地点状语 There, outside…home 前置，谓语 sit 放到主语 three angled solar panels 之前（正常语序 Three panels sit there…），用于场景描写；plugged into… 是｛过去分词短语作后置定语｝。

paragraphs.en: Unlike the highly technical and expensive hurdles required to install a large rooftop solar system, the setup on Andrew Leon and Victoria Mauro's lawn is small, portable, and cheap.
paragraphs.zh: 与安装大型屋顶太阳能系统所需的高度专业且昂贵的种种门槛不同，安德鲁·莱昂和维多利亚·莫罗家草坪上的这套装置体积小、可移动、价格低。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；Unlike… 是介词短语作｛比较状语｝；required to install… 是｛过去分词短语作后置定语｝，修饰 hurdles。

paragraphs.en: The unit generates enough electricity to run laptops, lights, and some appliances, including the refrigerator.
paragraphs.zh: 这台设备发的电足以带动笔记本电脑、电灯和部分电器，包括冰箱。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；enough electricity to run… 中｛不定式作定语｝，表程度。
ph: 驱动电器运转（run 为及物动词）

paragraphs.en: Plug-in solar, also known as balcony solar because apartment dwellers can use it, is spreading quickly across the U.S.
paragraphs.zh: 插电式太阳能——也叫"阳台太阳能"，因为住公寓的人也能用——正迅速遍及美国。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛现在进行时｝ is spreading；also known as… 是｛过去分词插入语｝；because 引导｛原因状语从句｝（一般现在时）。
ph: 公寓住户（dwell 居住，较正式）

paragraphs.en: California is the latest state to pass a law reducing the red tape that has previously stymied consumers looking to generate some electricity from a small number of solar panels.
paragraphs.zh: 加州是最新一个通过法律削减繁文缛节的州；此前这些官僚程序一直阻碍着想用少量太阳能板发点电的消费者。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛一般现在时｝；reducing… 是现在分词作后置定语；that has previously stymied consumers 是｛定语从句｝，用｛现在完成时｝表示从过去持续到立法前；looking to… 是｛现在分词短语作后置定语｝。
ph: 繁文缛节、官僚手续（不可数）

paragraphs.en: Utah was the first state to legalize balcony solar in the spring of 2025, and nine states subsequently passed similar legislation— Colorado, Connecticut, Maine, Maryland, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Vermont, Virginia, and now, California.
paragraphs.zh: 犹他州是 2025 年春首个将阳台太阳能合法化的州，随后九个州通过了类似立法——科罗拉多、康涅狄格、缅因、马里兰、新罕布什尔、新泽西、佛蒙特、弗吉尼亚，以及现在的加州。
paragraphs.gr: 并列句均为｛一般过去时｝（was / passed），因有明确过去时间 in the spring of 2025；the first state to legalize 中｛不定式作定语｝；破折号后是｛同位语｝列举。

paragraphs.en: New York lawmakers approved a bill that is awaiting the governor's signature, while nearly two dozen other state legislators have introduced them.
paragraphs.zh: 纽约州议员通过了一项法案，目前正等待州长签署；而另有近二十多个州的议员已经提出同类法案。
paragraphs.gr: 前句｛一般过去时｝ approved，定语从句 that is awaiting 用｛现在进行时｝表当前状态；while 是｛并列连词｝表对比"而"；后句｛现在完成时｝ have introduced，表迄今成果；them 指代同类法案。
ph: 等待某人签署（await＝wait for，较正式）
提出法案（议会固定用法）

paragraphs.en: Plug-in solar systems, typically comprised of one to three panels to stay below the maximum wattages allowed by the laws, enable users to save money on their power bills and to reduce the energy they use from power plants that generate electricity by burning fossil fuels.
paragraphs.zh: 插电式太阳能系统通常由一到三块面板组成，以保持在法律允许的最大功率以下；它能让用户节省电费，并减少从靠燃烧化石燃料发电的电厂所消耗的能源。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝长句，主干 Systems … enable users to save … and to reduce…；typically comprised of… 是插入语；to stay below… 是｛不定式表目的｝；allowed by the laws 是过去分词后置定语；they use 是省略 that 的｛定语从句｝；that generate electricity 又是修饰 plants 的定语从句；by burning… 是｛by + doing 方式状语｝。

paragraphs.en: "The appeal of being able to make your own electricity, and for less money than you can buy it from a utility, that's universal for Americans," says Joshua Pearce, an electrical engineer at Western University in Ontario, Canada, who advanced the merits of plug-in solar a decade ago.
paragraphs.zh: "能够自己发电，而且比从公用事业公司买电更便宜——这种吸引力对美国人是普遍存在的，"约书亚·皮尔斯说。他是加拿大安大略省西部大学的电气工程师，十年前就倡言插电式太阳能的优点。
paragraphs.gr: says 用｛一般现在时｝（新闻引述常用现在时）；引语采用｛左置位｝句式：先抛出话题 The appeal…utility，再用 that 指代（that's universal）；than 引导｛比较状语从句｝；who advanced…ago 是｛非限制性定语从句｝，｛一般过去时｝（a decade ago）。

paragraphs.en: (The link between extreme weather and climate change has never been clearer)
paragraphs.zh: （极端天气与气候变化之间的联系从未如此清晰。）
paragraphs.gr: ｛现在完成时｝ has never been + ｛比较级｝ clearer；"否定词 + 比较级"表｛最高级｝含义＝有史以来最清晰。
ph: the link between A and B
A 与 B 之间的关联

paragraphs.en: For most homes, electricity is generated in faraway power plants and transmitted through power lines.
paragraphs.zh: 对多数家庭来说，电在遥远的发电厂发出，再通过电线输送而来。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时被动语态｝并列：is generated … and transmitted（两个分词共用一个 is）。

paragraphs.en: Homes where rooftop solar creates electricity wire the energy into the home through the circuit breaker panel, and excess electricity flows back to the utility.
paragraphs.zh: 屋顶光伏家庭发的电经断路器配电箱接入屋内，多余的电则倒流回公用事业公司。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；where rooftop solar creates electricity 是修饰 Homes 的｛定语从句｝；主句中 wire 作｛动词｝，意为"布线接入"。

paragraphs.en: But power from plug-in systems stays in the home.
paragraphs.zh: 但插电式系统发的电只留在屋内。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；from plug-in systems 是介词短语作｛后置定语｝。

paragraphs.en: With a small metal box called an inverter attached to the panels and plugged into the outlet, electrical currents are pushed to other outlets throughout the residence.
paragraphs.zh: 面板连着一个叫"逆变器"的小金属盒，插入插座后，电流被推向整栋住宅里的其他插座。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时被动语态｝ are pushed；句首是｛with 复合结构｝：with + 宾语 a small metal box + 多个过去分词（called / attached / plugged）表伴随状态。
ph: 遍及整处住宅（residence 较正式）

paragraphs.en: Systems typically contribute 10 to 30 percent of an average home's use, says Jennifer Eden, who works on renewable energy programs for the policy nonprofit Utah Clean Energy.
paragraphs.zh: 这类系统通常承担一个普通家庭用电量的 10%–30%，珍妮弗·伊登说；她在政策类非营利组织"犹他清洁能源"从事可再生能源项目。
paragraphs.gr: says Jennifer Eden 是｛引述倒装｝，｛一般现在时｝；who works on… 是｛非限制性定语从句｝。

paragraphs.en: The set-ups have become especially popular in Europe.
paragraphs.zh: 这类装置在欧洲已格外流行。
paragraphs.gr: ｛现在完成时｝ have become，强调从过去到现在的变化结果。

paragraphs.en: Swedish furniture chain IKEA sells plug-in solar kits in Germany, a country where more than a million units have been installed in the past few years.
paragraphs.zh: 瑞典家具连锁品牌宜家在德国销售插电式太阳能套装；在德国这个国家，过去几年里已安装超过一百万套。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛一般现在时｝ sells；a country where… 是 Germany 的｛同位语 + 定语从句｝；从句｛现在完成时被动语态｝ have been installed，in the past few years 是现在完成时标志。
ph: 过去几年里（常配现在完成时）

paragraphs.en: As more U.S. states approve the technology and as more products become available, "this is going to take off like hotcakes," Pearce predicts.
paragraphs.zh: 随着更多美国州批准这项技术、更多产品上市，"这东西会火得一塌糊涂"，皮尔斯预测。
paragraphs.gr: 两个 As… 是｛时间状语从句｝，用一般现在时表将来条件；主句｛be going to｝表预测；Pearce predicts 用一般现在时引述。

paragraphs.en: With widespread adoption, residents could save an estimated $13 billion a year in electricity costs, he calculated in a 2017 journal article, a figure he says is higher now that electric rates have soared.
paragraphs.zh: 若得到广泛采用，居民每年估计可省下 130 亿美元电费——这是他在 2017 年一篇期刊论文中算出的数字；他说，由于电价已大幅上涨，这个数字如今更高。
paragraphs.gr: could save 用｛推测语气｝表理论上的可能；he calculated… 是插入语，｛一般过去时｝；a figure… 是 $13 billion 的｛同位语｝，后接省略 that 的定语从句；now that 引导｛原因状语从句｝，从句｛现在完成时｝ have soared；With widespread adoption 是"with + 名词"表条件。

paragraphs.en: People are especially pleased "there's now an entry point into solar that doesn't cost tens of thousands of dollars and can be used by people who don't own their home," Eden says.
paragraphs.zh: 人们尤其高兴的是，"现在有了进入太阳能领域的入口，不用花几万美元，连没有自有住房的人也能用"，伊登说。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝ be pleased + 省略 that 的｛宾语从句｝；there's an entry point… 是｛there be 句型｝；that doesn't cost … and can be used… 是｛定语从句｝（一主动一被动并列）；who don't own their home 又是定语从句。
ph: 拥有自有住房（与租客相对）

paragraphs.en: In states with especially high utility rates, residents reap substantial savings.
paragraphs.zh: 在电价特别高的州，居民能省下相当可观的钱。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；with especially high utility rates 是介词短语作｛后置定语｝。
ph: 公用事业费率（此指电价）
收获节省/好处（reap 收割→获得）

paragraphs.en: Nick Danz, who lives alone in a modern, two-bedroom luxury apartment in Fort Collins, Colorado, became eager for plug-in solar after reading about its popularity in Germany.
paragraphs.zh: 尼克·丹茨独自住在科罗拉多州柯林斯堡一套现代的两居室豪华公寓里；读到插电式太阳能在德国大受欢迎后，他对它心生向往。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛一般过去时｝ became（叙述人物故事）；who lives… 是｛非限制性定语从句｝，用一般现在时表长期事实；after reading about… 是｛介词 after + 动名词｝。

paragraphs.en: Colorado has more than 200 sunny days a year and Danz's apartment faces southwest, an optimal direction for sun collection.
paragraphs.zh: 科罗拉多一年有 200 多个晴天，而丹茨的公寓朝西南，那是收集阳光的理想朝向。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝并列句，陈述稳定事实；an optimal direction… 是 southwest 的｛同位语｝。

paragraphs.en: (Directly south is the most ideal.)
paragraphs.zh: （正南方向是最理想的。）
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；方位副词短语前置的倒装式表达，正常语序 The most ideal direction is directly south。

paragraphs.en: When, this summer, his state passed a law for plug-in systems, he reached out to the California-based clean-energy nonprofit Bright Saver.
paragraphs.zh: 今年夏天，当他所在的州通过针对插电式系统的法律后，他联系了总部位于加州的清洁能源非营利组织 Bright Saver。
paragraphs.gr: When 引导｛时间状语从句｝，｛一般过去时｝（this summer 插在主谓之间）；主句一般过去时 reached out；California-based 是｛复合形容词｝。

paragraphs.en: To encourage people to adopt renewable energy, Bright Saver sells plug-in systems without markups.
paragraphs.zh: 为了鼓励人们采用可再生能源，Bright Saver 按不加价的价格销售插电式系统。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；句首 To encourage… 是｛不定式作目的状语｝。

paragraphs.en: Danz paid under $300 for a one-panel unit and affixed it with metal clips over his small, third-floor balcony.
paragraphs.zh: 丹茨花了不到 300 美元买下一套单板设备，用金属卡夹把它固定在三楼的小阳台上方。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般过去时｝，并列谓语 paid … and affixed。

paragraphs.en: The system tripped his apartment's circuit breaker and shut off his computer several times, but a different inverter solved the problem.
paragraphs.zh: 这套系统好几次让他公寓的断路器跳闸、电脑断电，但换了一个不同的逆变器后问题解决了。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般过去时｝叙事：tripped … and shut off …（shut 的过去式同形），but 转折后 solved。
ph: 使断路器跳闸（电气固定说法）
切断电源、使停机（短语动词）

paragraphs.en: Danz estimates he has already saved more than $300 on his power bills since August.
paragraphs.zh: 丹茨估算，自 8 月以来他已经在电费上省下了 300 多美元。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛一般现在时｝ estimates；宾语从句｛现在完成时｝ has saved；since August 是完成时标志（since + 过去时间点）。

paragraphs.en: For the four days a week Danz is away from home working as a train conductor, "the solar panel is essentially running all of my standby items," he says.
paragraphs.zh: 丹茨的工作是列车长，每周有四天不在家；在这四天里，"太阳能板基本上在供着我所有待机中的电器"，他说。
paragraphs.gr: For the four days a week… 是介词短语作时间状语，内含省略 when 的｛定语从句｝ Danz is away…；working as… 是｛现在分词作伴随状语｝；引语｛现在进行时｝ is running，表该时段内持续进行。

paragraphs.en: He plans to soon move to an apartment with a larger balcony, where he hopes to hang three panels, the most his state's law allows.
hl: the most his state's law allows
paragraphs.zh: 他计划很快搬进一套阳台更大的公寓，希望在那里挂三块面板——这是他所在州法律允许的最大数量。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝ plans 表既定将来安排；to soon move 是｛分裂不定式｝（副词插在 to 与动词之间）；where 引导｛非限制性定语从句｝；the most (that) his state's law allows 是省略 that 的定语从句，作数量的｛同位语｝。

paragraphs.en: (Going off the grid to deal with climate disasters.)
paragraphs.zh: （脱离电网，以应对气候灾难。）
paragraphs.gr: ｛动名词短语｝（标题式省略句，无完整主谓）；to deal with… 是｛不定式作目的状语｝。
ph: 脱离公共电网（grid 电网）

paragraphs.en: Some utilities have expressed concern that plug-in units could send power back to the grid and electrocute employees working on the lines.
hl: send power back to the grid
paragraphs.zh: 一些公用事业公司表达了担忧：插电式设备可能把电送回电网，使正在线路上作业的员工触电身亡。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛现在完成时｝ have expressed；that 引导｛同位语从句｝（解释 concern 的具体内容，从句成分完整，不是定语从句）；could send / electrocute 表理论上的可能；working on the lines 是现在分词作后置定语。
ph: send power back to the grid

paragraphs.en: But Pearce found that no microinverters sold in the U.S. are capable of this.
paragraphs.zh: 但皮尔斯发现，美国销售的微型逆变器都做不到这一点。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛一般过去时｝ found；宾语从句用｛一般现在时｝ are，陈述当前客观事实（"主过从不过"的例外）；sold in the U.S. 是｛过去分词短语作后置定语｝。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year the testing company UL Solutions set safety standards for plug-in solar systems and has already certified one manufacturer.
paragraphs.zh: 今年早些时候，检测公司 UL Solutions 为插电式太阳能系统制定了安全标准，并且已经认证了一家制造商。
paragraphs.gr: 同一主语下两个时态并列：set 是｛一般过去时｝（earlier this year；set 过去式同形）；has certified 是｛现在完成时｝（already 强调对现在的影响）。

paragraphs.en: Pearce has also heard concerns that the energy being pumped into wall sockets could cause wiring in old homes to catch fire, but he says "that's never happened in Europe," despite its widespread adoption.
paragraphs.zh: 皮尔斯也听到过这样的担心：被注入墙上插座的电能可能导致老房电线起火；但他说"这种情况在欧洲从未发生过"，尽管该设备在那里已被广泛采用。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛现在完成时｝ has heard；that 是｛同位语从句｝，其中 being pumped into… 是｛现在分词被动式｝作后置定语（＝that is being pumped）；could cause…to do 表推测；that's never happened 是｛现在完成时｝；despite 是｛介词｝，后接名词短语，不能接句子。

paragraphs.en: In June the British government tested several products available in that country and found no direct electrical hazard, although some exhibited minor problems like not tripping the circuit breaker fast enough when stressed.
paragraphs.zh: 今年 6 月，英国政府测试了该国市面上的几款产品，没有发现直接电气危险；不过部分产品表现出小毛病，比如受压时断路器跳闸不够快。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般过去时｝连贯叙事 tested … and found …；although 引导｛让步状语从句｝（exhibited）；like 是｛介词｝，后接动名词 not tripping；when stressed 是｛状语从句省略｝＝when they were stressed。
ph: 在……能买到的产品（available 后置）

paragraphs.en: One impediment to interested buyers are local rules that may restrict balcony solar even in states where it is legal.
paragraphs.zh: 对感兴趣的买家来说，一个障碍是地方规定：即使在该设备已合法的州，地方层面也可能限制阳台太阳能。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；主语 One impediment 为单数、表语 local rules 为复数，谓语按｛意义一致｝用 are；that may restrict… 是｛定语从句｝（may 表可能性）；where it is legal 又是修饰 states 的定语从句。

paragraphs.en: Leon and Mauro discovered this the hard way when they placed their panels in front of their home, concerned the numerous trees behind their house would shade them.
paragraphs.zh: 莱昂和莫罗对此吃了苦头才明白：他们担心房子后面众多的树会遮光，就把面板放在了屋前。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般过去时｝；when 引导｛时间状语从句｝；concerned (that)… 是｛形容词短语作原因状语｝＝because they were concerned that…；从句 would shade 是｛过去将来时｝（主句为过去时，will 后移为 would）；them 指代 panels。
ph: （习语）吃了苦头才明白、惨痛地认识到

paragraphs.en: But a zoning employee soon knocked on their door and said city rules prohibited panels there.
paragraphs.zh: 但很快就有一名分区部门的工作人员来敲门，说城市规定禁止在那里放置面板。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般过去时｝并列 knocked … and said；said 后的宾语从句｛时态呼应｝，用一般过去时 prohibited。

paragraphs.en: The couple's plug-in panels remain in place while they work with the zoning board in hopes of loosening those restrictions.
paragraphs.zh: 这对夫妇的插电式面板目前仍留在原处，同时他们与分区委员会交涉，希望能放宽这些限制。
paragraphs.gr: 主句｛一般现在时｝ remain 表当前持续状态；while 引导｛时间状语从句｝（work，一般现在时），表与主句同时进行。

paragraphs.en: Leon and Mauro still draw power from the grid for their air conditioner and major appliances, but they have shaved nearly $100 total from Utah's typically low electric bills since May.
paragraphs.zh: 莱昂和莫罗开空调和使用大家电时仍然从电网取电，但自 5 月以来，他们已从犹他州本来就偏低的电费里总共省下近 100 美元。
paragraphs.gr: 前句｛一般现在时｝ draw 表长期习惯；but 后｛现在完成时｝ have shaved（since May 为完成时标志）。

paragraphs.en: Mauro especially loves the benefit to the environment, because solar energy does not emit the greenhouse gasses that lead to climate change.
paragraphs.zh: 莫罗尤其看重它对环境的好处，因为太阳能不会排放导致气候变化的温室气体。
paragraphs.gr: ｛一般现在时｝；because 引导｛原因状语从句｝；that lead to climate change 是修饰 gasses 的｛定语从句｝。

paragraphs.en: Experts estimate that even the energy used to produce the solar panels is offset in less than two years of use.
paragraphs.zh: 专家估计，即便是制造这些太阳能板所消耗的能源，也会在投入使用不到两年内被抵消。
paragraphs.gr: 主句一般现在时 estimate；宾语从句｛一般现在时被动语态｝ is offset，表客观结论；used to produce… 是｛过去分词短语作后置定语｝（此处 used to 意为'被用来'，不是'过去常常'）。

paragraphs.en: "When we first heard about it, we thought it seemed way too good to be true, to just plug a solar panel into the wall and generate electricity," Mauro says.
paragraphs.zh: "刚听说这东西时，我们觉得它好得太离谱、不可能是真的——就把一块太阳能板插进墙上插座就能发电，"莫罗说。
paragraphs.gr: When…heard 是｛一般过去时｝；主句 thought 后宾语从句｛时态呼应｝用 seemed；to just plug … and generate… 是｛不定式短语｝，说明句中 it 的具体内容；Mauro says 用一般现在时引述。
ph: （口语）实在太……（way 为程度副词，＝far）

paragraphs.en: "But it turned out that really was all we had to do to produce clean energy and save money."
paragraphs.zh: "但结果证明，要生产清洁能源又省钱，我们真的只需做这些就够了。"
paragraphs.gr: it turned out (that)… 是｛固定主从结构｝，｛一般过去时｝；(that) we had to do 是修饰 all 的｛定语从句｝（先行词为 all 时关系代词用 that 或省略，不用 which）；to produce … and save… 是｛不定式作目的状语｝。
ph: that is all sb has/had to do
